name: Payment Status Reason 1 Choice
definition: Reason for the status of the payment transaction.

Unmatched.name: Unmatched
Unmatched.definition: Reason why the payment status is unmatched.

Cancelled.name: Cancelled
Cancelled.definition: Reason why the payment status is cancelled.

Suspended.name: Suspended
Suspended.definition: Reason why the payment status is suspended.

PendingFailingSettlement.name: Pending Failing Settlement
PendingFailingSettlement.definition: Reason why the payment status is pending (failing settlement).

PendingSettlement.name: Pending Settlement
PendingSettlement.definition: Reason why the payment status is pending (settlement).

ProprietaryRejection.name: Proprietary Rejection
ProprietaryRejection.definition: Defines the reason that has been used by the system to reject the transaction.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Defines a free text proprietary reason.
